Bring Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases. **About Intelligence Center X**Intelligence Center X (ICX) is Siemens' industrial AI platform. ICX combines Siemens' own core graph, ontology, machine learning and agentic AI technology with our industrial software foundations to bring truly differentiated capabilities to market. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it. Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services. **How we engage with customers:**Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward. **Key Responsibilities:**The roleAs an ICX Engineer, you lead the ideation and creation of these engagements. This is a presales FDE role: you take a business problem and a complex data landscape, model the domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver a working agentic application with a business case compelling the customer to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens. You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the ICX Engineering Manager for the EMEA region. **An example engagement**An industrial manufacturer wants its engineers to answer in minutes a question that today takes weeks of chasing across teams: what does this change affect? The answer is spread across a dozen systems that each describe the same products, parts and suppliers differently. You connect them, model how they fit together as an enterprise ontology, build an agent that reasons over the result, and show the customer what it is worth with a compelling agentic user experience. **Requirements:**Who you are- **You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology**. You build working things, and agentic development tools are how you work. If some of this is new to you, you will learn fast.- **You are entrepreneurial.** You take ownership, move at startup pace and find a route to an outcome before the problem is fully defined — with some of the largest companies in the world.- **You think in business value,** and you want to be in the room with customers. **Skills and experience**We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas.- **Customer-facing technical communication** — running working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including when the solution is still taking shape.- **Data engineering and analytics** — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it.- **Modern data and AI platforms** — experience architecting or integrating solutions across modern cloud, data and AI ecosystems such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai.- **Agentic AI** — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP.- **Agentic development tools** — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well.- **Enterprise ontology** — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise.- **Machine learning and data science** — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification.- **FDE, presales or innovative professional services** — experience on a team that builds with customers.- **Technical consulting** — designing and building agentic AI, data and analytics solutions for clients at a consultancy or systems integrator.- **Experience in our industries** — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services. We hire across levels, from recent graduates to experienced data and AI professionals, with no minimum years of experience. What matters is evidence that you build, and the drive to do it with customers. **Travel**Some travel is expected, up to 25%. For people who want to spend even more time on site with customers, there is room for it. **Why Join Us**- **Grow with ICX.** Lead as Siemens brings Intelligence Center X to the market as a leading industrial AI platform.- **Shape our future.** ICX Engineering is growing fast, and strong leaders get the opportunity to shape where it goes.- **The problem every enterprise is working on.** Agentic AI grounded in a company's own data and context.- **A direct line to product.** Your engagements help shape the ICX roadmap.- **A clear path to grow.** ICX Engineers grow toward Principal or management roles. At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! **Our Benefits & Rewards**The total cash compensation range for this position is €85,100 to €215,700 with 30% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. titel: Senior Agentic AI Infrastructure and Digital Twin Engineer (f/m/d)
text: **We are ONE Siemens** Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software is a suite of integrated digital solutions to engineer, simulate and operate manufacturing operations across industries. Operations Software includes our product portfolio in manufacturing engineering (COMOS, Tecnomatix, NX CAM, ...) & production operations (Win CC, Scada, PCS 7 / neo, Opcenter, Insights Hub, ...). The portfolio helps organizations across many different industries to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance decision-making by providing real-time visibility and control across manufacturing and business processes. Formula 1 cars, ships, mobile phones, space exploration vehicles, food & beverages, pharmaceuticals and many of the other objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and produced using our software. We're redefining the industrial world using data and AI to make production: Agile, Adaptive, Autonomous. Eliminate productivity boundaries for today’s and tomorrow’s production operation. Join our mission to build the most comprehensive next generation AI-native Industrial Operations Software portfolio as the new operation system for industry in the age of AI. With us you have the chance to now apply AI to where it really matters: In the physical world of an industrial production and engineering of real things. As part of Siemens Operations Software (OPS-SW), the Supervisory & Control Systems organization drives the full-lifecycle management of industrial software portfolios—including WinCC, PCS 7, PCS neo, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), and Industrial Edge. The organization manages these solutions from development through to deployment, connecting the digital and physical worlds to enable advanced monitoring and control. By overseeing the entire product lifecycle, it supports customers in building agile, data-driven, and increasingly autonomous production environments.Build the virtual factory infrastructure in which our agentic AI tools for factory automation are demonstrated and tested. You will own a realistic simulation-based sandbox with industrial data sources, events and controllable failure modes that agents can query and act on through APIs.**Your Area Of Impact** - Designing and building a virtual factory: Use existing Siemens simulation and digital twin tools to provide realistic production data, events and controllable failure modes for agents.- Providing stable simulation APIs: Enable agents to query states, trigger events and validate proposed actions, and define the APIs together with the runtime and skills teams.- Developing reproducible scenarios: Create a versioned scenario library covering normal operations, disruptions, quality deviations, supply delays and conflicting demands, each with a reproducible initial state and defined expected outcomes.- Creating a multi-tenant test environment: Work with the external teams responsible for instance provisioning so that prospective customers can experience how agents interact with industrial data sources.- Enabling LLM-free validation: Provide the simulation component of validation by making the digital twin an instrument that agents consult before making recommendations or taking actions.- Supplying benchmark environments: Support evaluation and regression testing of skills, agent configurations and model changes.- Automating the simulation stack: Automate installation and reset, specify hosting-platform requirements and ensure full integration into existing CI/CD pipelines where needed.- Coordinating simulation contributions: Collaborate with Siemens simulation units and, where applicable, external partners contributing models or plant data. **Your Success Is Based On** - **Education**- A degree in engineering, simulation, computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - **Experience & Skills**- Professional experience: At least five years of experience with industrial simulation or digital twin tools such as Plant Simulation, Process Simulate, NX or comparable solutions, including model development and API integration.- Manufacturing expertise: Strong understanding of production-plant behavior, including material flow, orders, machines, quality, maintenance and potential failure modes.- Software engineering: Solid Python skills and experience exposing simulation functionality through services, together with familiarity with containerized deployments.- Test design: Experience designing reproducible test scenarios with clearly defined expected outcomes.- Infrastructure and observability: Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD design and MQTT or OPC UA observability on Kubernetes.- Simulation-based validation: Experience using simulation as a validation or decision-support instrument, rather than exclusively for planning, is an advantage.- Agentic AI: Experience with LLM-based applications and an interest in how agents should consult digital twins is an advantage.- Demonstration environments: Experience building demonstration environments for customers or trade shows is an advantage.- AI-first development: Hands-on experience in AI-first development environments with deep integration of different tools into AI-driven pipelines is an advantage. - **Ways of working:** Structured, quality-focused and comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of industrial simulation content, models, APIs and scenarios while collaborating with globally distributed infrastructure, runtime and skills teams.- **Languages:** Fluent English is required; German is an advantage. **Join our Digital World** At Siemens Digital Industries Operations Software, flexibility is how we work — hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. We build technology that shapes the real world. You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial operations software leader. We’re committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! **Our Benefits & Rewards** The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers a wide range of health and wellness benefits to employees. You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you! Your individual personality and perspective are important to us. We create a working environment that reflects the diversity of the society and support you in your personal and professional development. Let’s get to know your authentic personality and create a better future together with us. As an equal-opportunity employer we are happy to consider applications [from individuals with disabilities](https://www.siemens.com/de-de/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/). Protecting the environment, conserving our natural resources, fostering the health and performance of our people as well as safeguarding their working conditions are core to our social and business commitment at Siemens.
